title.en: Jesus presented; Casadó to Deportivo; Yamal named AFE best player
title.es: Presentado Jesus; Casadó al Deportivo; Yamal, mejor jugador de la AFE

deck.en: Gabriel Jesus spoke at his unveiling after the medical. Window closed with three more academy exits. Lamine Yamal collected the AFE award. Clásico set for 25 October.
deck.es: Gabriel Jesus habló en su presentación tras la médica. Mercado cerrado con tres salidas más de cantera. Lamine Yamal recogió el premio de la AFE. El Clásico, el 25 de octubre.

headline.en: Gabriel Jesus presented: pay cut, perfect knee and no offence at plan B label
headline.es: Presentado Gabriel Jesus: bajada de sueldo, rodilla perfecta y sin ofensa por ser plan B

summary.en: Gabriel Jesus was presented at Camp Nou on Tuesday after passing his medical. He signed until 30 June 2029 for a reported €10m fixed fee from Arsenal. The Brazilian said he took a significant pay cut because the move was a dream and that his knee is no longer a problem.
summary.es: Gabriel Jesus fue presentado en el Camp Nou el martes tras superar la médica. Firmó hasta el 30 de junio de 2029 por unos 10 millones fijos del Arsenal. El brasileño dijo que bajó significativamente el sueldo porque el fichaje era un sueño y que la rodilla ya no es un problema.

body.en:
Jesus told the room he was not offended by the Julián Álvarez comparison. "It does not offend me that they say I am plan B or C. What bothers me is not playing football. I have the chance to be at Barcelona." He added that the last two years after the ACL injury had been difficult but that the knee is now "the past".

He confirmed conversations with Raphinha, Rodri, Cancelo and Eric García before accepting the deal. Flick had described the signing as a surprise opportunity the club could not ignore. Jesus watched the 5-2 win over Rayo from the stands on Monday and is expected to join the group later this week ahead of the Valencia trip.

headline.en: Marc Casadó agrees loan move to Deportivo with €30m option
headline.es: Marc Casadó acuerda cesión al Deportivo con opción de 30 millones

summary.en: Deportivo reached a verbal agreement on Tuesday night to take Marc Casadó on loan from Barcelona. Fabrizio Romano reported a €30m buy option. The midfielder had yet to sign the paperwork as formal steps continued into the evening.
summary.es: El Deportivo alcanzó un acuerdo verbal el martes por la noche para llevarse a Marc Casadó cedido del Barça. Fabrizio Romano habla de una opción de compra de 30 millones. El centrocampista aún no había firmado mientras se completaban los pasos formales.

body.en:
Casadó has limited first-team minutes under Flick this season and was among the academy products whose contracts were being reviewed in the final hours of the window. Víctor Navarro reported the player was at the airport early on Wednesday morning for a flight to Galicia.

SPORT and Mundo Deportivo had tracked the talks through the afternoon. The structure protects Barcelona’s long-term interest while giving the midfielder regular football at a side fighting for promotion. Formal announcement is expected once the documents are exchanged.

headline.en: Toni Fernández joins Venezia; Álvaro Cortés heads to Royal Antwerp
headline.es: Toni Fernández ficha por el Venezia; Álvaro Cortés se marcha al Antwerp

summary.en: Barcelona confirmed two further academy departures on Tuesday. Toni Fernández moves to Venezia with a buy-back clause and sell-on percentage retained. Álvaro Cortés joins Royal Antwerp under the same protection structure.
summary.es: El Barça confirmó el martes dos salidas más de cantera. Toni Fernández se marcha al Venezia con opción de recompra y porcentaje de futura venta. Álvaro Cortés ficha por el Royal Antwerp con la misma estructura de protección.

body.en:
Both deals follow the pattern used with Héctor Fort and earlier exits. The club clears contracts that lack a clear path into Flick’s squad while keeping future value. Fernández, 18, was entering the final year of his deal. Cortés is a defensive prospect who needed regular minutes.

The announcements came in the final hours before the Spanish window closed. Guille Fernández’s move to Mallorca had already been completed earlier in the day. Deco’s department prioritised profit and salary relief over retaining depth that was not going to feature.

headline.en: Lamine Yamal named AFE Best Player in Primera and receives World Cup career award
headline.es: Lamine Yamal, mejor jugador de Primera según la AFE y premio a la trayectoria por el Mundial

summary.en: The Asociación de Futbolistas Españoles named Lamine Yamal Best Player in the First Division for the previous season. He also received the Sporting Career Award recognising his contribution to Spain’s World Cup win.
summary.es: La Asociación de Futbolistas Españoles nombró a Lamine Yamal Mejor Jugador de Primera División de la temporada anterior. También recibió el Premio a la Trayectoria Deportiva por su contribución al título mundial de España.

body.en:
The club posted the double honour on Tuesday evening. Yamal had already collected multiple individual awards through the spring and summer. The AFE recognition is voted by the players themselves and carries weight inside the dressing room.

His start to the new season has been sharp. Two goals in the 5-2 win over Rayo on Monday took his early tally higher and continued the form that made him the standout performer in the previous campaign. Flick has repeatedly said the winger’s mood and output remain high.

headline.en: Clásico date confirmed: 25 October at Spotify Camp Nou, 21:00
headline.es: Fecha del Clásico confirmada: 25 de octubre en el Spotify Camp Nou, 21:00

summary.en: LaLiga and the club confirmed the first Clásico of the season will be played on 25 October at Spotify Camp Nou. Kick-off is set for 21:00 CEST in gameweek 10. José Mourinho’s Real Madrid side will be the visitors.
summary.es: LaLiga y el club confirmaron que el primer Clásico de la temporada se jugará el 25 de octubre en el Spotify Camp Nou. Saque inicial a las 21:00 en la jornada 10. El Real Madrid de José Mourinho será el visitante.

body.en:
The announcement came on Tuesday afternoon. Barcelona sit top of the early table after three wins from three. Real Madrid are level on points. The October date sits after the opening Champions League fixtures and before the international break that follows.

Mourinho’s return to the fixture adds another layer. The Portuguese coach has already spoken about the need to close the gap on Flick’s side. Ticket and broadcast details will follow closer to the match.

headline.en: Window closes with no further first-team arrivals after Jesus
headline.es: El mercado cierra sin más fichajes de primer equipo tras Jesus

summary.en: Barcelona shut the door on new first-team signings once Gabriel Jesus completed his medical and presentation. Deco and Flick agreed the squad is covered in every area for the first half of the season. Centre-back reinforcement remains a possible January topic.
summary.es: El Barça cerró la puerta a nuevos fichajes de primer equipo una vez Gabriel Jesus completó la médica y la presentación. Deco y Flick coinciden en que la plantilla está cubierta en todas las líneas para la primera parte de la temporada. El central sigue siendo tema posible de enero.

body.en:
Reports from Marca and Goal indicated the club had monitored Alessandro Bastoni and other centre-backs but abandoned the idea once the summer spend reached roughly €162m across Rodri, Gordon, Adeyemi and Jesus. The sporting department will watch the defensive numbers through the autumn.

Outgoing traffic continued until the deadline. In addition to the academy sales, several fringe players remain available for loan if clubs come forward. The registration list for the first half of the season is now effectively locked.

tweets.name: BarcaFutbolLive
tweets.text: Window closed. Jesus was the last first-team arrival. Squad list is set.

headline.en: Raphinha and Yamal both score twice in 5-2 win over Rayo
headline.es: Raphinha y Yamal marcan dos cada uno en el 5-2 al Rayo

summary.en: Barcelona beat Rayo Vallecano 5-2 at Spotify Camp Nou on Monday night. Raphinha and Lamine Yamal scored twice each. An own goal completed the scoring. The result left the side top of the table with nine points and a +10 goal difference.
summary.es: El Barça venció 5-2 al Rayo Vallecano el lunes por la noche en el Spotify Camp Nou. Raphinha y Lamine Yamal marcaron dos cada uno. Un autogol completó el marcador. El resultado dejó al equipo líder con nueve puntos y +10 de diferencia de goles.

body.en:
Rayo took an early lead through Camello before Barcelona responded. Raphinha equalised and Yamal put the home side ahead. A Lejeune own goal extended the advantage. Camello pulled one back, but Raphinha and Yamal added late goals to settle the contest.

Attendance was reported above 57,000. Flick praised the attacking output and the response after falling behind. The next Liga fixture is away at Valencia on Sunday before the Champions League opener against Feyenoord on 9 September.

headline.en: Jesus expected to train with the group later this week
headline.es: Jesus se espera que entrena con el grupo a partir de esta semana

summary.en: Gabriel Jesus completed the medical and presentation on Tuesday. Club sources indicate he will begin training with the first-team group in the coming days. Flick wants him available for consideration against Valencia on Sunday.
summary.es: Gabriel Jesus completó la médica y la presentación el martes. Fuentes del club indican que empezará a entrenar con el primer equipo en los próximos días. Flick quiere tenerlo disponible para el partido del domingo en Valencia.

body.en:
The Brazilian had been training separately at Arsenal in the final weeks while the deal was negotiated. He told the presentation he felt physically ready after the long recovery from the 2025 ACL injury. The medical battery at the Hospital de Barcelona and the Ciutat Esportiva produced no concerns.

Registration with LaLiga was completed before the midnight deadline. Jesus becomes the sixth summer arrival after Rodri, Gordon, Adeyemi, Livaković and the earlier additions. His versatility across the front line gives Flick additional options for the dense September calendar.

headline.en: Man United interest in Balde cools after deadline-day check
headline.es: El interés del Manchester United por Balde se enfría tras el contacto de última hora

summary.en: Manchester United made a late enquiry about Alejandro Balde on deadline day but the move did not progress. English and Spanish coverage reported the left-back remains a Barcelona player with no agreement reached.
summary.es: El Manchester United realizó una consulta de última hora por Alejandro Balde en el cierre de mercado, pero la operación no avanzó. La prensa inglesa y española confirma que el lateral sigue siendo jugador del Barça sin acuerdo alguno.

body.en:
Reports from The Athletic and Football365 indicated United explored a loan structure late on Tuesday. Barcelona had no intention of selling a core defender and Balde himself was not pushing for an exit. The contact ended without formal negotiations.

Balde has started the season as Flick’s first-choice left-back. The episode fits the pattern of several Premier League clubs testing the market in the final hours without finding willing sellers at Camp Nou.

tweets.text: Balde stays. United interest reported but nothing progressed before the window shut.

headline.en: Raphinha leads La Liga scoring charts after three matchdays
headline.es: Raphinha lidera la tabla de goleadores de La Liga tras tres jornadas

summary.en: Raphinha has five goals in three Liga matches, scoring in every round. The Brazilian is the first Barcelona player to open a season with goals in the first three games since Lionel Messi. Lamine Yamal sits close behind on the early charts.
summary.es: Raphinha lleva cinco goles en tres partidos de Liga, marcando en todas las jornadas. El brasileño es el primer jugador del Barça que abre una temporada con goles en los tres primeros partidos desde Lionel Messi. Lamine Yamal está cerca en la tabla provisional.

body.en:
The club highlighted the run on Tuesday. Raphinha’s two goals against Rayo took him clear at the top of the scoring list. His link-up play with Yamal and the new wide options has given Flick a flexible front line even before Jesus is fully integrated.

The early numbers also reflect the improved chance creation from midfield. Pedri and the returning minutes of Gavi and Rodri have started to stabilise the supply. Valencia away on Sunday is the next test of the scoring run.
